verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Everything I am, everything I long to be
I lay it down at Your feet (x2)

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I lay it down x3
At Your feet

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
Oh pearl of greatest price
No act of sacrifice

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Can match the gift of life
I find within Your gaze

verse.name: b1c
verse.lines:
Oh, what a sweet exchange
I die to rise again

verse.name: b1d
verse.lines:
Lifted up from the grave
Into Your hands of grace
